propositions: A signed gate verdict records only a model string and cannot distinguish verdicts produced behind opaque gateways (e.g., Bedrock-backed vs Anthropic-backed) from the same provider:model pair.

The provider_provenance object must be added as an additive, optional field containing provider, model, endpoint_host (hostname only, never credentials), tier (first_class or best_effort), and effective capabilities record.

The provenance record must be assembled once per run in capabilities.py from primitives, reusing the already-computed ModelCapabilities to avoid silent divergence from the record that actually drove execution.

Verdicts persisted by all three sidecars (plan_review, completion, code_review) must carry provider_provenance from the runner result through gate orchestration paths unchanged to preserve the signed manifest.
The persisted payload must never leak credential material from base_url userinfo or api_key, enforced by using urlparse(base_url).hostname instead of .netloc.
Legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must continue to load and verify, maintaining backward compatibility across unsigned and signed records.
